title: Segmental Resection Combined With DEP Regimen for EBV-HLH Patients With Intestinal Involvement
off: Efficacy and Safety of Segmental Resection Combined With the DEP Regimen for Epstein-Barr Virus Associated Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis With Intestinal Involvement
summary: EBV-HLH is a rare disease with high mortality, especially for those with intestinal involvement. In order to reduce disease burden and improve survival of these patients, we conduct a prospective observational study to explore the efficacy and safety of segmental resection combined with the DEP regimen.
desc: Epstein-Barr virus associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis is a rare disease with high mortality, especially for those with intestinal involvement. Some of them still died despite early control of the disease due to severe complications, such as gastrointestinal bleeding. In order to reduce disease burden and improve survival of these patients, we conduct a prospective observational study to explore the efficacy and safety of segmental resection combined with the DEP regimen.

arms.d: Epstein-Barr virus associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis patients with imaging confirmed intestinal involvement
i: Other: Segmental bowel resection combined with the DEP regimen

interventions.n: Segmental bowel resection combined with the DEP regimen
